title: 'We'll do it': PM Modi gives slogan for 2047 goals
content: PM Narendra Modi delivered a speech highlighting his 25 years in government and the goal of developed India by 2047. He called upon citizens to commit to this ambitious target and emphasized the power of the people. Modi reiterated the importance of extraordinary goals, linking good governance to societal inclusion. He reflected on his journey from humble beginnings to leadership in the BJP.

title: FBI foils alleged ISIS-linked attack plot at Mall of America by 18-year-old
content: Sheikhdoon Abdullahi Mohamud, an 18-year-old, was arrested for planning an attack on the Mall of America. He agreed to buy an AK-47 and ammunition from an undercover FBI agent posing as an ISIS member. Mohamud expressed intentions to kill non-Muslims during a scheduled Hmong arts celebration. US authorities stated that his radicalization was identified well before his plan could be executed.

title: UK's oldest Indian restaurant owner accuses Crown Estate of not valuing curry traditions
content: Ranjit Mathrani, the owner of Veeraswamy, is taking legal action against the Crown Estate over lease refusal. He believes this reflects an undervaluation of Indian culinary traditions compared to European cuisine. The restaurant has a significant historical background with notable patrons, including Indian leaders. The Crown Estate maintains its decision is based on structural issues and not culinary bias.

title: ​IndiGo flight hit by lightning, damage found only after landing in Lucknow
content: An IndiGo flight experienced a lightning strike while approaching Lucknow, damaging its nose radome. The aircraft landed safely, with all 110 people onboard unharmed. The severity of the damage became clear only after the flight was parked. Authorities confirmed that the aircraft will undergo a comprehensive inspection and necessary repairs before service. The Directorate General of Civil Aviation has been notified as per standard procedure.

title: Google ordered to halt data center work in 'Texas of Europe; company admits ‘concerns’
content: Google has received an order to halt construction on its data center projects in Muhos and Kajaani. The Finnish Licensing and Supervision Agency has mandated that construction continues only after environmental impact assessments. Google acknowledged the concerns raised and stated that it would comply with the authority's guidance. The company has emphasized its commitment to biodiversity plans, including extensive tree planting.

title: Arnold Schwarzenegger donated $250,000 to build 25 shelters for homeless veterans
content: In 2021, Arnold Schwarzenegger donated $250,000 to Village for Vets to help provide temporary shelters for homeless veterans in Los Angeles. Before Christmas, 25 tiny shelters were installed at the VA campus in West Los Angeles. Each provided a bed, climate control, electricity and a locking door, giving veterans who had been living on the streets a safer place to stay while moving towards stable housing.

title: A lunch, then a march: How Rahul-led opposition once again kept police guessing
content: The episode was the latest example of a 'dhappa' style protest that Rahul Gandhi and the Congress have recently used. The latest episode began after Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge announced an INDIA bloc sit-in at Jantar Mantar following the lunch. "Today, we will hold a sit-in protest at Jantar Mantar. Until our demands are met, we will continue to stage such protests," Kharge announced.

title: Oceans connect, not divide nations, PM Modi says, calls for secure maritime order
content: PM Narendra Modi emphasized the importance of maritime connectivity and proposed a ceasefire plan for the Black Sea. His vision promotes cooperation and mutual benefit among nations to ensure maritime security. Chief of Naval Staff Admiral Krishna Swaminathan highlighted the interconnectedness of national security and economic security. He urged for collective action among regions to tackle maritime threats effectively.

title: NIA court rejects bail plea of separatist Shabir Shah in 1996 funeral violence case
content: A Jammu NIA court rejected the bail application of Shabir Ahmad Shah, linked to a 30-year-old mob violence case. This case relates to violence during a terrorist's funeral procession in Srinagar, which Shah allegedly incited. The court expressed concern about potential threats to national security and the safety of protected witnesses. Shah argued that the investigation was reopened without justification and emphasized delays in legal actions.

title: Florida billionaire’s $80m oceanfront estate now asks $165 million
content: Larry Ellison is putting his North Palm Beach estate back on the market, initially acquired for $80 million, now with a hefty asking price of $165 million. Spanning 8.4 acres and featuring direct beachfront access within a gated community, the estate boasts luxurious amenities. Despite potential redevelopment plans, the existing home remains.

title: Thrift shopper paid $1.50 for purse; Cartier piece later valued at $35,000
content: A thrift-store shopper who paid just $1.50 for a clutch in 2018 or 2019 discovered years later that it was a rare Cartier Art Deco piece. During a 2026 "Antiques Roadshow" appraisal, experts identified precious stones, platinum and the Cartier name inside, valuing the purse at about $35,000, with an insurance value above $100,000.

title: Priscilla Chan founded a school; 10 years later, Board votes to close it
content: Priscilla Chan's tuition-free private school in California has shut down after receiving over $125 million in funding. The school, which aimed to support low-income children and families, faced challenges leading to its closure. About 540 children were enrolled, and families expressed concern over the abrupt announcement of the closure. The Chan Zuckerberg Initiative pledged $50 million to assist with transition services and education savings accounts.

title: Texas court lets oil company cross 1,604-acre ranch to plug shut-in well
content: A Texas appeals court ruled that Allegiant Resources can access McFaddin Ranch to plug an inactive well. The dispute centers around the Remora Oil Unit No. 1 located near the San Antonio River. Virginia L. Dierlam, the ranch owner, previously secured a permanent injunction that limited access to the ranch. Allegiant argues that plugging the well is necessary to avoid environmental concerns, which the court acknowledged.

title: Grenade seizure case: Pakistan-based ultra declared ‘proclaimed offender’
content: A special NIA court in Jammu has declared Nazir Hussain a proclaimed offender regarding grenade seizures. Hussain, originally from Hari village, is believed to be hiding in Pakistan currently. The court noted that previous non-bailable arrest warrants could not be executed due to his absence from home. Additionally, multiple attempts to compel Hussain to surrender have been unsuccessful.

title: Travis Kelce and Patrick Mahomes’ 1587 Prime lawsuit: Why are they fighting it?
content: Patrick Mahomes and Travis Kelce are facing continued legal pressure over their Kansas City steakhouse, 1587 Prime. The NFL stars asked a court to dismiss a trademark lawsuit filed by 1587 Sneakers, which claims the restaurant’s name could confuse consumers. The sneaker company has strongly opposed their dismissal bid, arguing Mahomes and Kelce played an active role in creating the “1587” brand. The case remains ongoing.

title: Juan Soto’s $765M contract: How will it reshape his fortune?
content: Juan Soto’s record-breaking New York Mets contract is more than a landmark baseball deal. Its $765 million value, $75 million signing bonus, lack of deferred payments and 2029 opt-out give Soto unusual control over his financial future, also, the structure could influence his investment opportunities, earning power, tax planning and wealth accumulation throughout his career and beyond.

title: India’s first high-altitude snow leopard safari flagged off in Ladakh
content: Ladakh has commenced India's first high-altitude wildlife safari that highlights snow leopard trails and community involvement. Vinai Kumar Saxena, the lieutenant governor, emphasized the importance of coexisting wildlife and development. The Snow Leopard and High-Altitude Nature Conservation Society is coordinating this project with local forest departments. The mapped safari routes traverse significant wildlife areas, including Hemis National Park and Changthang.

title: ‘Nobody can stop Bumrah & Bhuvi’: Ashwin’s bold prediction as pacer makes India return
content: Ravichandran Ashwin asserts that Bhuvneshwar Kumar’s display in New Zealand might have a significant impact on his chances for World Cup selection. Having last participated in an ODI in 2022, Bhuvneshwar is set to make his return to international cricket. His capacity to swing the ball could enhance India's bowling lineup for next year’s championship.

title: Delhi building collapse: Pregnant woman, child among 3 killed in Seemapuri; 8 injured
content: In Seemapuri, Delhi, a tragic building collapse resulted in the loss of three lives, including a child, with eight others injured. The incident, which occurred around 3.15 PM, activated swift rescue operations by both locals and authorities. Concerns about the building’s structural stability arose following recent earthquakes in Uttarakhand. Investigations into the cause of the collapse are ongoing, with local traffic also disrupted due to the incident.

title: From 'vote chori' to 'chita andolan': Street protests return with a new playbook
content: From 'vote chori' protests and women’s safety marches to 'Chita Andolan', the streets are getting politically crowded again. But the old politics of protest now comes with a new playbook. Younger voices, looser networks, social media, viral slogans and issue-based mobilisation are changing how protests begin, spread and draw attention.

title: Out on bail after rape allegation, Porel named in Bengal squad for Ranji opener
content: Wicketkeeper-batter Abhishek Porel has been included in Bengal's squad for their upcoming Ranji Trophy match. He was previously arrested on allegations of rape but has since been granted bail. The team has named a strong squad with senior pacers Mohammed Shami and Akash Deep included. Bengal's match against Delhi is set to take place in Kalyani to mark the season opener.

title: ‘Changed Shreyas’ grip & backlift’: How Nayar helped India T20I captain bounce back
content: Facing a troubling drop in performance, with no scores exceeding 30 in his last ten T20I outings, Shreyas Iyer turned to Abhishek Nayar for help. Their two-hour conversation revolved around critical adjustments to Iyer's batting style. The results were evident as Iyer responded with a stellar 102 not out in the first T20I against West Indies, underscoring his tenacity and capacity to rebound from tough situations.

title: Messi’s former Barca teammate Pedro retires at 39 after glittering 25-trophy career
content: Pedro Rodriguez bids farewell to football after an illustrious 20-year journey, celebrated at clubs like Barcelona and Chelsea, where he amassed numerous trophies. A member of the victorious Spanish team at the 2010 FIFA World Cup and Euro 2012, he leaves behind a legacy of 794 club appearances and 197 goals. His retirement follows closely behind that of Lionel Messi, signaling the closure of a golden chapter in the sport.

title: Tanker attacks in Strait of Hormuz highest in a week since Iran war began: Report
content: Last week, attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz reached a high level of activity. There were at least twelve incidents reported involving various types of vessels. This surge coincides with Gulf producers increasing their oil exports significantly. The International Maritime Organisation also reported nine separate incidents during the same timeframe. Overall, these developments cast doubts on the stability and security of maritime operations in the region.

title: California home hid miniature town and railway in backyard; sold for $415,000
content: A stunning home in East Hemet, California, has recently changed hands, boasting a remarkable model train city as its centerpiece. This three-bedroom, two-bath residence also features a luxurious pool and spa, enhancing outdoor enjoyment. The property's elaborate train setup adds to its allure, capturing the interest of buyers looking for a unique property. The final sale price reflects both its distinctiveness and competitive positioning in the local real estate market.

title: California couple spent $300,000 fixing damage, then got $676,703 county bill
content: A California couple says Santa Clara County entered their property to address a landslide threatening a public road, left the hillside damaged and later billed them $676,703.22 for the work. The couple says it spent more than $300,000 repairing hazardous conditions allegedly caused by the county. A federal judge has now dismissed their current complaint but allowed them to amend several constitutional claims, keeping part of the legal battle alive.

title: ‘He deserves the same’: England legend laments Ronaldo’s finale compared to Messi’s
content: Gary Lineker expressed his sadness over the conclusion of Cristiano Ronaldo's international journey, contrasting it with Lionel Messi's heartfelt farewell with Argentina. While Messi received an emotional send-off, Ronaldo's exit was steeped in controversy. Lineker advocates for a more fitting tribute to Ronaldo's legacy, recognising his significant impact on football.

title: Nobel Chemistry 2026: How Kagan, Soai solved century-old 'mirror-image' mystery
content: Henri B Kagan of France and Kenso Soai from Japan were honored with the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for 2026. They unveiled the fascinating reason why living organisms favor left-handed amino acids over right-handed ones. Their groundbreaking research focused on generating pharmaceuticals that utilize only the beneficial mirror form of amino acids.

title: What is military exemption? Why South Korea weighs cuts after Asian Games backlash
content: Following inflammatory comments from football players, South Korea is rethinking its policy on military service exemptions for athletes. This reevaluation comes amidst public outcry over the equity of the existing regulations. Culture and Sports Minister Chae Hwi-young noted a shift in societal attitudes towards military service, leading the Defence Ministry to explore removing additional service requirements for athletes.

title: Rajinikanth's 'Jailer 2' censor and runtime revealed
content: The highly awaited sequel 'Jailer 2' featuring superstar Rajinikanth is set to release in theatres on October 15. Recently completing its censor clearance with a UA 16+ rating, the film runs for a total of 165 minutes, ensuring a grand cinematic experience. Bolstered by an impressive cast that includes Vidya Balan and Mohanlal, director Nelson Dilipkumar aims to elevate the franchise to new heights.

title: In videos: Angry Priyanka Gandhi 'holds the ground' as cops drag her away
content: Rahul Gandhi had stepped up his attack on Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar, who has been in the Opposition's crosshairs over his functioning and reported dissent among his subordinates. Rahul Gandhi, declaring that he would launch a fresh protest from Jantar Mantar, said, “Gyanesh Kumar will have to resign,” and called him an “illegitimate” poll body chief.

title: ‘Just own it’: Lineker urges Man City to accept punishment over financial breaches
content: Gary Lineker has called on Manchester City to take responsibility for their financial misconduct and the resulting penalties. He argues that acceptance of accountability is crucial for restoring the integrity of English football. The independent commission identified City's use of fraudulent contracts to distort financial realities across several seasons. Lineker noted that reversing titles could negatively impact players and supporters.

title: Ohio neighbour cut 15-foot spruce; court upholds $11,523.87 damages
content: A court decision in Whitehouse, Ohio, underscores the necessity of neighborly communication after Michael Meier unlawfully removed a 15-foot spruce tree from the Longs' yard. The Lucas County Court imposed treble damages totaling $11,523.87 for the loss, while a higher court dismissed the Longs' adverse possession claims. This case serves as a reminder of the repercussions of negligence and the importance of keeping property matters documented.
